.flip-container, .front, .back {
    /*width: 118px;*/
    /*margin: 8px 0;*/
    margin-bottom: 1px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 1px;
}

    .flip-container.submodules, .flip-container.submodules .front, .flip-container.submodules .back {
        width: 190px;
        height: 148px;
        margin: 8px 0;
    }



/* hide back of pane during swap */
.front, .back {
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    transition: 0.6s;
    /*transform-style: preserve-3d;*/
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    padding: 22% 0;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    border-radius: 10px
}

    .back.card {
        background: #f1387c;
    }

    .back h4 {
        font-size: 13px;
    }

/*  UPDATED! front pane, placed above back */
.front {
    z-index: 2;
    transform: rotateY(0deg);
}

/* back, initially hidden pane */
.back {
    transform: rotateY(-180deg);
}

<div class="example-container" [@routerTransition]>
    <div class="example-loading-shade" *ngIf="!modules">
        <mat-spinner *ngIf="!modules"></mat-spinner>
    </div>
    <mat-card class="dashBG">
        <mat-card-content class="classforieedge" *ngIf="!isVendorType && !isLoadingResults">
            <div class="row">
                <div class="col-md-2">

                    <ng-container *ngIf="entityShortName == 'IN'">
                        <mat-card-title class="iptile"><h4 class="SubHeadLinks">HR Partner</h4></mat-card-title>
                        <div class="contactMain hrPartner" style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom: 12px;padding: 2px 0;">
                            <p><span class="hrLbl">HR Partner Name  :</span><span class="hrValu">{{BuHrName}} ({{BuHrEmpNo}})</span></p>
                        </div>

                        <ng-container *ngIf="BuddyName">
                            <mat-card-title class="iptile"><h4 class="SubHeadLinks">Buddy</h4></mat-card-title>
                            <div class="contactMain hrPartner" style="font-size:11px;margin-bottom: 12px;padding: 2px 0;">
                                <p><span class="hrLbl">Buddy Name  :</span><span class="hrValu">{{BuddyName}} ({{BuddyEmployeeNo}})</span></p>
                            </div>
                        </ng-container>

                    </ng-container>

                    <ng-container *ngIf="tenantMasterId != 7 && tenantMasterId != 13">
                        <mat-card-title class="iptile"><h4 class="SubHeadLinks">Popular Links</h4></mat-card-title>
                        <mat-spinner *ngIf="isLoadingPopularLinks"></mat-spinner>
                        <ul class="list-group ipLinks" *ngIf="!isLoadingPopularLinks">
                            <li *ngFor="let pl of popularLinks" class="list-group-item">
                                <a href="{{pl.href}}" target="_blank">{{pl.name}}</a>
                            </li>
                            <li class="list-group-item" *ngIf="popularlinktype === 'popularLinkszyter'">
                                <a (click)="openZyterHolidayList()">Zyter India Holidays</a>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    </ng-container>

                </div>
                <div class="col-md-7 home_cont_area cont_area">
                    <ng-container *ngFor="let module of modules;trackBy: trackByFn">
                        <div class="col-sm-2 col-md-2 flp-div mod-{{module.id}}" *ngIf="module.submodules.length > 0 && module.relativeUrl != 'raisehand'"
                             style="padding:0;">
                            <div class="flip-container flip">
                                <div class="flipper card" (click)="redirectModuleByName(module.relativeUrl,module.id,module.moduleName,module.iconPath,module.bgColorClass)" matTooltip="{{module.moduleDescription}}" [ngClass]="actModule == module.id ? 'activebox mod-'+module.id :''">
                                    <ng-container *ngIf="currentTheme == 'StyleSheet' || currentTheme == 'StyleSheet-dark'">
                                        <img width="70" height="55" src="{{this._bizxrooturi.bindBaseURL() + '/dist/assets/images/module_images/purplewhite/' + module.moduleName}}.png" />
                                    </ng-container>
                                    <ng-container *ngIf="currentTheme == 'StyleSheet-blue'">
                                        <img width="70" height="55" src="{{this._bizxrooturi.bindBaseURL() + '/dist/assets/images/module_images/purplewhite/' + module.moduleName}}.png" />
                                    </ng-container>
                                    <ng-container *ngIf="currentTheme == 'StyleSheet-darkBlue'">
                                        <img width="70" height="55" src="{{this._bizxrooturi.bindBaseURL() + '/dist/assets/images/module_images/purple/' + module.moduleName}}.png" />
                                    </ng-container>
                                    <h4 class="core-mod-title" ngClass="{{module.id}}">{{module.moduleName}}</h4>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </ng-container>
                </div>

                <div class="col-md-3" *ngIf="actModule && submodules.length > 0" ngClass="{{animatedArea}}">
                    <mat-card-title class="iptile">
                        <h4 class="SubModHeadLinks" ngClass="{{ 'mod-'+ actModule}}">
                            <img src="{{this._bizxrooturi.bindBaseURL() + '/dist/assets/images/module_images/purplewhite/' + titleName }}.png"
                                 style="width: 20px;margin-right: 16px" />{{titleName}}
                        </h4>
                    </mat-card-title>
                    <ul class="list-group moduleLinks">
                        <li class="list-group-item" *ngFor="let module of submodules;trackBy: trackByFn">
                            <a ngClass="{{module.id}}" (click)="redirectSubModuleByName(module.subModuleRelativeUrl,module.subModuleName,module.id,module.iconClass)">{{module.subModuleName}}</a>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>

            <sg-employee-information *ngIf="selectedTenantName == 'SG'" [InputEmployeeNumber]="employeeUID"></sg-employee-information>

        </mat-card-content>
    </mat-card>
    <!-- Your Flip End-->
</div>

<div class="loading-shade"
     *ngIf="isLoadingResults">
    <mat-spinner *ngIf="isLoadingResults"></mat-spinner>
</div>



import { Component, OnInit, Inject } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable, Subscription } from 'rxjs';

import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ApplicationURL } from '../../models/applicationURLs';
import { Module, Submodule } from '../../models/moduleClaimModel';
import { routerTransition } from '../../router.animations';
import { HeaderComponent } from '../header/header.component';
import { DynamicMenuService } from '../../services/dynamicmenu.service';
import { EmployeeService } from '../../services/employeeService';
import { UtilityService } from '../../services/commonUtil';
import {
    CandidateListForCreatingEmployee
} from '../../models/onBoardingModel';
import { BaseURL } from '../../models/applicationURLs';
import { SGEmployeeInformationComponent } from '../../directives/sg-employee-information/sg-employee-information';
import { ELMService } from '../../services/elmService';
import { LeaveService } from '../../services/leaveService';
import { EmployeeMaster } from '../../models/EmployeeMaster';
import { ThemeService } from '../../services/theme.service';
import { IndexedDbService } from '../../services/indexed-db.service';
import { MatDialog, MatDialogRef, MAT_DIALOG_DATA } from '@angular/material';
@Component({
    selector: 'home',
    templateUrl: './home.component.html',
    styleUrls: ['./home.component.css'],
    animations: [routerTransition()],
    providers: [DynamicMenuService, EmployeeService, BaseURL, UtilityService, ELMService, LeaveService]
})
export class HomeComponent implements OnInit {
    submodules: Submodule[];
    public modules: Module[];
    selected: any;
    item: any;
    titleName: string;
    actModule: number = 0;
    currentTheme: string;
    animatedArea: any;
    tenantMasterId: any;
    public entityShortName: string;
    employeeUID: string = localStorage.getItem("UID");
    selectedTenantName: string = '';
    allEntities: any[];
    popularLinks: any[];
    popularlinktype: string = 'popularLinks';
    bgColorClassLink: string = '';
    employeeMasterHR: EmployeeMaster;
    isLoadingResults: boolean = false;
    isLoadingPopularLinks: boolean = false;
    isVendorType: boolean = false;
    BuHrName: any; BuHrEmpNo: any;
    BuddyName: any; BuddyEmployeeNo: any;
    zyterHolidayImageBase64 = ""

    private themeSub: Subscription;

    constructor(private http: HttpClient,
        private _applicationUrl: ApplicationURL,
        private _route: Router,
        private dataService: DynamicMenuService,
        private _employeeService: EmployeeService,
        private _bizxrooturi: BaseURL,
        private _utilityService: UtilityService,
        private _themeService: ThemeService,
        private _elmService: ELMService,
        private _leaveService: LeaveService,
        private _dbService: IndexedDbService,
        public dialog: MatDialog
    ) {

        var retrievedObject = localStorage.getItem('loadEmployeeDetailsById');

        this.employeeMasterHR = JSON.parse(retrievedObject);

        if (localStorage.getItem("IsZyter")) {
            this.popularlinktype = localStorage.getItem("IsZyter");
        }
        else if (localStorage.getItem("entityShortName") === "US") {
            this.popularlinktype = "usPopularLinks";
        }

        this.getCurrectActiveTheme();
    }

    trackByFn(index: any, item: any) {
        return index; // or item.id
    }

    ngOnDestroy() {
        if (this.themeSub) this.themeSub.unsubscribe();
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {

        this.themeSub = this._themeService.theme$.subscribe(theme => {
            this.currentTheme = theme;
        });

        this.isLoadingResults = true;

        this._utilityService.getStaticMasterDataFromJsonByRoleTypeName("Vendorhome").subscribe(result => {

            if (result != null) {

                var RoleName = result ? result.roleName : '';

                var typeName = RoleName.split(',').filter(x => x === this.employeeMasterHR.employeeType)[0];

                if (typeName) {
                    this.isVendorType = true;
                    this._route.navigate(["/vendorhome"]);
                } else {
                    this.getPopularLinks();
                    this.GetBuHrDataByEmployeeUID();
                }

                this.isLoadingResults = false;
            }

        }, error => { });

        this.tenantMasterId = localStorage.getItem("tenantMasterId");
        var retrievedObject = localStorage.getItem('bindModules');
        this.modules = JSON.parse(retrievedObject);
        this.entityShortName = localStorage.getItem("entityShortName");

        if (localStorage.getItem("moduleMasterId")) {
            let moduleMasterId = parseInt(localStorage.getItem("moduleMasterId"));
            let subModuleList: any = this.modules.filter(x => x.id == moduleMasterId)[0];
            this.submodules = [];
            let moduleUrl = localStorage.getItem("moduleRelativeUrl");

            if (moduleUrl === "informationsecurity") {
                const keepWords = ["soc-landing", "https://infinite.humanfirewall.io/userportal/login"];
                let filteredSubmodules = subModuleList.submodules.filter(
                    item => keepWords.some(word => item.subModuleRelativeUrl.includes(word))
                );

                this.submodules = filteredSubmodules;
                this.titleName = "Information Security";
            }
            else {
                this.submodules = subModuleList.submodules;
                this.titleName = subModuleList.moduleName;
            }

            this.actModule = moduleMasterId;
        }


    }

    getPopularLinks() {

        const self = this;
        self.isLoadingPopularLinks = true;

        this._dbService.getItemByKey("PopularLinks").then(function (data) {
            if (data) {
                var parsedData = JSON.parse(data);
                self.popularLinks = parsedData;
                self.isLoadingPopularLinks = false;
            } else {
                self.http.get(self._bizxrooturi._baseUrl + 'dist/assets/js/' + self.popularlinktype + '.json?v=' + new Date().getMilliseconds()).subscribe((resp: any[]) => {
                    if (resp) {
                        self.isLoadingPopularLinks = false;
                        self.popularLinks = resp;
                        self._dbService.setItem("PopularLinks", JSON.stringify(resp));
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    getCurrectActiveTheme() {
        this.currentTheme = localStorage.getItem("currentTheme");
    }


    GetBuHrDataByEmployeeUID() {

        const self = this;

        this._dbService.getItemByKey("GetBuHrDataByEmployeeUID").then(function (data) {
            if (data) {

                var parsedData = JSON.parse(data);
                self.BuHrName = parsedData[0].buhrname;
                self.BuHrEmpNo = parsedData[0].buhrEmpNo;
                self.BuddyName = parsedData[0].BuddyName;
                self.BuddyEmployeeNo = parsedData[0].BuddyEmployeeNo;
            } else {
                self._elmService.GetBuHrDataByEmployeeUID(self.employeeUID).subscribe(Result => {
                    if (Result.content.authenticated) {
                        if (Result.content.data) {
                            self._dbService.setItem("GetBuHrDataByEmployeeUID", JSON.stringify(Result.content.data));
                            self.BuHrName = Result.content.data[0].buhrname;
                            self.BuHrEmpNo = Result.content.data[0].buhrEmpNo;
                            self.BuddyName = Result.content.data[0].BuddyName;
                            self.BuddyEmployeeNo = Result.content.data[0].BuddyEmployeeNo;
                        }
                    }
                }, error => { console.log(error); });
            }
        });

    }

    select(item: any) {
        this.selected = item;
        this.animatedArea = 'w3-animate-left';

    };
    isActive(item: any) {
        return this.selected === item;
    }

    redirectModuleByName(moduleUrl: string, id: number, moduleName: string, iconPath: string, bgColorClass: string) {

        if (iconPath == "DirectURL") {

            this.submodules = [];
            this.actModule = id;

            if (moduleName == 'Brand Vault') {
                (window).open(moduleUrl, "_blank");
            }
            else {
                let containsAllSubStrs = moduleUrl.includes("infinitehorizons");

                if (containsAllSubStrs) {
                    localStorage.setItem("moduleRelativeUrl", "infinitehorizons");
                }

                const products = ['https://spandan-apps.infinite.com/ustimesheet-form/', 'https://spandan-apps.infinite.com/pms/'];
                const atLeastOne = products.some(item => moduleUrl.includes(item));
                if (atLeastOne) {
                    (window).open(this._utilityService.redirectModuleByRelativeURLExternal(moduleUrl, localStorage.getItem("x-access-token"), localStorage.getItem("securityStamp"), localStorage.getItem("loginName")), "_blank");
                }
                else {
                    (window).open(moduleUrl, "_blank");
                }
            }
        }
        else {

            this.animatedArea = '';
            this.actModule = id;
            this.bgColorClassLink = bgColorClass;
            localStorage.setItem("moduleMasterId", id.toString());
            localStorage.setItem("moduleRelativeUrl", moduleUrl);
            localStorage.setItem("moduleName", moduleName);

            if (moduleUrl === "informationsecurity") {

                const selectedModule = this.modules.find(m => m.id === parseInt(localStorage.getItem("moduleMasterId")));
                const keepWords = ["soc-landing", "https://infinite.humanfirewall.io/userportal/login"];
                let filteredSubmodules = selectedModule.submodules.filter(
                    item => keepWords.some(word => item.subModuleRelativeUrl.includes(word))
                );

                this.submodules = filteredSubmodules;
                this.titleName = moduleName;

            }
            else {
                let subModuleList: any = this.modules.filter(x => x.id == id)[0];

                this.submodules = subModuleList.submodules;
                this.titleName = subModuleList.moduleName;
            }

            this.animatedArea = 'w3-animate-left';

        }
    }

    redirectSubModuleByName(subModuleRelativeUrl: string, subModuleName: string, id: number, iconClass: string) {
        localStorage.setItem('ReportMasterId', '0');
        localStorage.setItem('ChildReportMasterId', '0');
        localStorage.setItem("subModuleMasterId", id.toString());
        localStorage.setItem("moduleLevelSecond", subModuleRelativeUrl);

        const moduleRelativeUrl = this.getModuleRelativeUrlBySubModuleMasterId(id);

        let containsAllSubStrs = moduleRelativeUrl.includes("infinitehorizons");
        let currentTheme = localStorage.getItem("currentTheme");
        //let moduleRelativeUrl = localStorage.getItem("moduleRelativeUrl");
        //let externalModuleApps = localStorage.getItem("ExternalModuleApps");

        if (moduleRelativeUrl === "informationsecurity" && iconClass === "DirectURL") {
            (window).open(subModuleRelativeUrl, "_blank");
        }
        else if (moduleRelativeUrl === "deliverystatus" && iconClass === "DirectURL") {
            (window).open(subModuleRelativeUrl, "_blank");
        }
        else if (containsAllSubStrs) {
            (window).open(this._utilityService.generateExternalBizXRedirectLink("infinitehorizons", localStorage.getItem("x-access-token"), localStorage.getItem("securityStamp"), subModuleRelativeUrl, "", id.toString(), subModuleName, currentTheme), "_self");
        }
        else if (moduleRelativeUrl.toLowerCase().match(/^(billregister|mis|proposal|veritas|deliveryexcellence|projectaccounting|timesheeto2c|timesheetv2|budget|travelv2|audit|employeecare|leavev2|payout|bgcv2|corehrv2|elmv2|trainingv2|infinitehorizons|deliverystatus|employeeinformation|nomination|informationsecurity|assetv2|rootzv2|onboardingv2|visav2|incidentmanagementv2|servicemanagementv2|skillpackv2|clientv2|projectv2|expensev2|procurementv2|recruitmentv2|auditv2|reportv2|misv2|invoicetimesheet|projectreview)$/)) {
            let trimtitle = this.titleName.toLocaleLowerCase().replace(" ", "");
            if (moduleRelativeUrl.toLowerCase() == "incidentmanagementv2") {
                if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident") {
                    localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "1");
                } if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident For Others") {
                    localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "0");
                }
            }
            (window).open(this._utilityService.generateExternalBizXRedirectLink(moduleRelativeUrl, localStorage.getItem("x-access-token"), localStorage.getItem("securityStamp"), subModuleRelativeUrl, trimtitle, id.toString(), subModuleName, currentTheme), "_self");
        }
        else {

            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "recruitment-request")
                localStorage.removeItem("RecruitmentMasterObj");
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "expense") {
                localStorage.removeItem("ExpenseparamJson");
            }
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "edit-employee-information" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "employee-list" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "my-team-project") {
                localStorage.removeItem("CoreHREmpObj");
            }

            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "sg-edit-employee-information" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "sg-employee-information-list") {
                localStorage.removeItem("sgCoreHREmpObj");
            }
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "purchase-request-non-consultant") {
                localStorage.setItem("PrNumber", "0");
                localStorage.setItem("isPendingPR", "2");
            } if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "generate-non-consultant-po") {
                localStorage.setItem("poListIem", JSON.stringify(""));
                localStorage.setItem("POStatus", "2");
                localStorage.setItem("isEditPO", '0');
            } if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident") {
                localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "1");
            } if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident(behalf of others)") {
                localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "0");
            }
            if (subModuleName == "Expense Report") {
                localStorage.setItem("fromDate", null);
                localStorage.setItem("toDate", null);
            }
            if (subModuleName == "Create Vendor Consultant") {
                var obj = new CandidateListForCreatingEmployee();
                obj.id = 0;
                localStorage.setItem("pendingNewEmployeeJson", JSON.stringify(obj));
            }

            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "assigned-service-request-list" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "assigned-incident-list" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "assign-incident-list" || subModuleRelativeUrl == "assign-service-request-list") {
                localStorage.setItem("IncidentDashboardData", '');
                localStorage.setItem("fromPage", '');
                localStorage.setItem("dashboardType", '');
            }

            if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident") {
                localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "1");
            }
            if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident For Others") {
                localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "0");
            }
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "assign-incident-list") {
                localStorage.setItem("assignIncidentPage", '0');
            }
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "assign-service-request-list") {
                localStorage.setItem("assignSRPage", '0');
            }
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "employee-information" && (localStorage.getItem('tenantMasterId') == '18' || localStorage.getItem('tenantMasterId') == '19'))
                subModuleRelativeUrl = 'employee-information-costa-rica';
            if (subModuleRelativeUrl == "initiate-resignation-list" && (localStorage.getItem('tenantMasterId') == '18' || localStorage.getItem('tenantMasterId') == '19'))
                subModuleRelativeUrl = 'initiate-resignation-list-costa-rica';

            let trimtitle = this.titleName.toLocaleLowerCase().replace(" ", "");
            if (trimtitle == "invoicingtimesheet") { trimtitle = "timesheet" }
            this._route.navigate(["/" + trimtitle + "/" + subModuleRelativeUrl]);
        }
    }

    getModuleRelativeUrlBySubModuleMasterId(subModuleMasterId: number) {
        for (const mod of this.modules) {
            if (mod.submodules.some((sub: any) => sub.id === subModuleMasterId)) {
                return mod.relativeUrl.toLocaleLowerCase();
            }
        }
        return localStorage.getItem("moduleRelativeUrl");
    }

    openZyterHolidayList() {
        this.dialog.open(ZyterHolidayListDialog, {
            minWidth: '40%',
            data: {
                imageUrl: this.zyterHolidayImageBase64
            }

        });
        
    }
}

}

import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient, HttpParams } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { Router } from '@angular/router';
import { ApplicationURL } from '../../models/applicationURLs';
import { Module, Submodule } from '../../models/moduleClaimModel';
import { routerTransition } from '../../router.animations';
import { HeaderComponent } from '../header/header.component';
import { DynamicMenuService } from '../../services/dynamicmenu.service';
import { EmployeeService } from '../../services/employeeService';

@Component({
    selector: 'menu-dashboard',
    templateUrl: './menu-dashboard.html',
    styleUrls: ['./home.component.css'],
    animations: [routerTransition()],
    providers: [DynamicMenuService, EmployeeService]
})
export class MenuDashboard implements OnInit {
    titleName: string;
    moduleMasterId: number;
    public modules: Module[];
    submodules: Submodule[];
    selected: any;
    item: any;
    constructor(private http: HttpClient,
        private _applicationUrl: ApplicationURL,
        private _route: Router,
        private dataService: DynamicMenuService,
        private _employeeService: EmployeeService) {
        let mId = localStorage.getItem("moduleMasterId");
        if (mId) {
            this.moduleMasterId = parseInt(mId);
        } else {
            this._route.navigate(["/home"]);
        }
    }

    ngOnInit(): void {

        var retrievedObject = localStorage.getItem('bindModules');
        this.modules = JSON.parse(retrievedObject);
        let subModuleList: any = this.modules.filter(x => x.id == this.moduleMasterId)[0];
        
        this.submodules = subModuleList.submodules;
        this.titleName = subModuleList.moduleName;
    }

    select(item: any) {
        this.selected = item;

    };

    isActive(item: any) {
        return this.selected === item;
    }

    redirectSubModuleByName(moduleUrl: string, subModuleName: string, id: number, relativeUrl: string) {    
        localStorage.setItem('ReportMasterId', '0');
        localStorage.setItem('ChildReportMasterId', '0');
        localStorage.setItem("subModuleMasterId", id.toString());
        localStorage.setItem("moduleLevelSecond", moduleUrl);
        if (moduleUrl == "recruitment-request")
            localStorage.removeItem("RecruitmentMasterObj");
        if (moduleUrl =="expense") {
            localStorage.removeItem("ExpenseparamJson");
        }
        if (moduleUrl == "edit-employee-information" || moduleUrl == "employee-list") {
            localStorage.removeItem("CoreHREmpObj");
        }
        if (moduleUrl == "sg-edit-employee-information" || moduleUrl == "sg-employee-information-list") {
            localStorage.removeItem("sgCoreHREmpObj");
        }
        if (moduleUrl == "purchase-request-non-consultant") {
            localStorage.setItem("PrNumber", "0");
            localStorage.setItem("isPendingPR", "2");
        } if (moduleUrl == "generate-non-consultant-po") {
            localStorage.setItem("poListIem", JSON.stringify(""));
            localStorage.setItem("POStatus", "2");
        } if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident") {
            localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "1");
        }
        if (subModuleName == "Raise Incident For Others") {
            localStorage.setItem("selfIncident", "0");
        }
        if (moduleUrl == "assign-incident-list") {
            localStorage.setItem("assignIncidentPage", '0');
        }
        if (moduleUrl == "assign-service-request-list") {
            localStorage.setItem("assignSRPage", '0');
        }
       
        localStorage.setItem("moduleLevelSecond", subModuleName);
        
        let trimtitle = this.titleName.toLocaleLowerCase().replace(" ", "");
        this._route.navigate(["/" + trimtitle + "/" + moduleUrl]);
    }
}
